style.toneOfVoiceUnformatted: Add a little holly-jolly holiday joy to your home or office with this Pre-Lit Decorative Xmas Tree from HOMCOM! Pre-sprung with 200 clear warm lights that remain lit even if a bulb burns out, this tree comes decorated with faux ornament balls, sure to delight throughout the season and spread Christmas cheer. The pine-styled tree stands up to 1.8m tall with a 1.12m diameter, made of dense PVC needles and 745 branches that create a natural and full appearance that lasts all season. The pre-lit 200 LED lights add a festive glow to your home, while Christmas ornaments are spread throughout the branches. The sturdy, foldable metal base provides stability to keep your tree standing tall, and the tree is easy to assemble and disassemble for convenient storage. Perfect for indoor Christmas decoration, it helps to fill your space with festive atmosphere. For the fullest results, it is recommended to work from bottom to top, spreading each branch in a spiral motion. The tree’s dimensions are F112 x 180H cm, with a net weight of 7kg. The transformer voltage is 100-240V/50Hz, with a cord length of 1.8m and power of 3.6W. The input voltage is 31V, and the branch tip count is 745.
